apply.title: Organization registration
apply.lead: Register a club, district or private fishery. You will become its administrator, and once the platform administrator activates it you can claim your waters and start selling permits.

admin.title: Organizations

members.inviteHint: We will send a link valid for {{days}} days. Only an account with this email address can accept the invitation; anyone without one creates an account first.

accept.lead: Accept the invitation to join the organization.

accept.mismatchHint: Log out and log in to the account with the address the invitation was sent to — or ask the organization to invite this address.
